overclaims: Failures to generalize do not establish that no genuine improvement occurred; some gains transferred to independent tests [e2, e3].
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, axis, outcome and evidence metadata are correct. A limitation says 'some gains transferred to independent tests' and cites e2 and e3. Only e3 shows gains carrying over to new test sets. In e2 the models nearly always predicted entailment on HANS, with near-zero accuracy on non-entailment cases. That is shortcut reliance, not a gain carrying over, so the e2 citation is unsupported. The rationale sentences themselves are supported, with correct dates.

The proposition matches. e4 (May 2022 van den Broeck preprint) and e5 (April 2018 NAACL study) support the rationale, with correct dates. The limitations note that e4 is a preprint and that the evidence covers selected tasks. Axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews. Evidence excerpts are short but verbatim.
